title: Frontend: Searchable Dropdown
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Searchable Dropdown. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App({options=[Apple,Banana,Cherry]}). Controlled Search options combobox filters case-insensitively and opens a listbox #choices. Buttons role=option display matches; empty matches show No options. Click selects one option, fills query and closes. Display selected label. Output is [data-testid=selected]. Escape closes without clearing selection; ArrowDown advances highlight and Enter selects it.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Separate input query, highlighted option, selected value, and popup visibility.
alternativeApproaches: Fetch suggestions asynchronously and prevent an older response from replacing newer matches.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: No results; arrow navigation; disabled option.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
